_comment: Input to tools/backfill-app.py: how an existing document's project (`app`, a KB_APP term) is inferred. Reviewed by Peter before any apply. Values must be KB_APP terms; the script checks each one resolves before touching anything.
_repo_ids: FR-YAC repo -> FR-YAC; World-in-a-Pie -> backend; WIP-KB (its repo_id is a comma-joined double root) -> KB.
_infer_from_author_roles: LESSON / DESIGN_DECISION / FIRESIDE carry no project field, only authored_by. They are tagged only when their YAC authors (Peter ignored) include roles from this list and those map to exactly ONE app. BE-YAC and FRanC are left out on purpose: what they write usually spans the constellation, so their lessons and firesides stay untagged rather than all becoming 'backend' or 'FR-YAC'.
